text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: You're getting stronger and stronger. If I leave you alone, will all the swimsuits in the world disappear?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どんどん強くなってんねー
ほっとくと、
世界中の水着が消えてなくなるカモ？

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: I won't let that happen...! Let's defeat him right here and now...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのような事態にはさせません……！
ここで、
一気に倒しましょう……！

text_block_list.name: Misora
text_block_list.text: Lili, it's time to show off the fruits of your training♪ You're up against a slime that melts your clothes, so be prepared to cum!★
text_block_list.orig_text:
リリちゃん、
修行の成果を披露する時ですよ♪
服を溶かすスライムが相手だろーと、
玉砕覚悟でイッちゃってください★

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am! I'll be leaving now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい……！
粉骨砕身、
不惜身命！
いってまいります！

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Wow, Riri-chan in a swimsuit is so serious~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
わー
水着リリちゃん
マジセッキョクテキ～♡
